meta.title: Rev3.0 Oven Controller — Glass Front
meta.subtitle: Visual overview: what it is, what every piece is, how we make it

one_line.t: A flush, printed, strengthened glass front for the oven's 7-inch touch screen: glass, plastic lip and steel lie in one plane, with the same {m.border} mm black border on all four sides.

cover_note.t: Design of record GF-2.1. Independently re-checked: 120 pass / 0 fail / 54 info. Still gated by a fold test on one real panel before anything is ordered. All costs in this document are desk estimates; no supplier has been asked.

readers.t: For the owner and the business partner. Pictures first; numbers are taken from the master parameter file and the design document.

what.why_title: Why it is built this way

why.t: The glass sits in the cut-out, not on top of it: no bezel stands proud of the steel.
Its 1.0 mm lip fills the sheet thickness; the sheet edge rests on the frame, so lip and steel are flush.
The sheet is only laser cut and stud-welded; one aluminium mould makes the frame.
Two bench jigs: J1 bonds the screen to the glass, J2 bonds the glass to the frame flush.

variants_caption.t: The two fixing variants on the front (GF-D40, UI indicative): S4 shows nothing; R4 shows four black Ø14 rivet heads, 1.5–2.0 mm proud.

process_page.title: How we make it, step by step
process_page.title2: How we make it, step by step (continued)

intro.t: Stations of §9.1. Times are hands-on minutes per unit (estimates in the design document, marked [A]); waiting times are cure times.

what.t: Every glass: outline gauge and R6.25 corner template. First frames: CMM. Sheet: cut-out and coated thickness.

tools.t: go/no-go gauge, corner template, light box, micrometer

risk.t: A glass outside ±0.1 (±0.2 if quoted) or a corner outside R6.25 closes the corner gap.

what.t: Dispense ≈ 5.2 mL LOCA, lower the glass onto the stops, align the window 1–3 px inside the lit border, UV tack.

wait.t: full cure 72 h (moisture) or 1–4 h at ≤ 60 °C (2K)

tools.t: J1, UV LED, 2 USB microscopes, HEPA hood

risk.t: Dust or bubbles in the window, or a window edge not 1–3 px inside the lit pixels on all four sides.

what.t: Stick the Formex onto the frame shelf; prime the land and the tape band.

risk.t: Silicone residue near the optical-bond station: it kills ink and LOCA adhesion.

process.title: Bead, cables, flush bond in J2

what.t: Glass + panel face down on J2; fold the cables up, thread them through the slot; lower the frame onto the plate.

tools.t: J2, fold gauge, tail-holder kit, 5 kg ring weight

risk.t: A cable or the card touching the fresh bead: lift the frame, clean, start again. Tail handling is not tried yet.

process.title: Fold cables over the nose, tape

what.t: After the cure, fold each cable over the R1.5 nose into its compartment; lay the four tape strips, liner on.

risk.t: A cable bent tighter than the nose, creased, or in the wrong compartment.

what.t: PCB on the 9 bosses, cables into J10 / J11, latches closed; display and touch test.

risk.t: Q1 leads not trimmed to ≤ 2.5 mm reach through the Formex into the panel.

what.t: Lower the module into the sheet from behind, centre it with 8 shims, press, then fit the nuts crosswise at 0.6 Nm.

wait.t: pressure frame ≥ 20 min; tape 90 % at 24 h

tools.t: pressure frame, PTFE shims, torque driver

risk.t: Taking the pressure frame off early: the tape springs back and the steel stands proud.

what.t: Dial gauge at 12 points round the cut-out; gaps by feeler on every side and corner; flushness again after 24 h.

risk.t: Accept only: flush within ±0.15; g1 sides 0.30–0.55; g2 sides 0.20–0.60; corners at most 0.80.

variant_panel.title: S4 or R4 — what changes (decision D4, open; S4 recommended)

rows.t: S4: 4 studs welded to the back of the sheet before coating; washers and nyloc nuts (items 2, 10, 11). Nothing shows on the front.
R4: 4 holes Ø5.2 in the sheet after coating; large-flange rivets set from the front (items 14, 15). Black Ø14 heads stand 1.5–2.0 mm proud.
Both: the same frame, glass, tape strips and cut-out; only the sheet drawing differs (GF-D01 or GF-D03).
